title: Understanding the Honda CR-V Hybrid E-Drive
summary: WeberAuto explains how the Honda E-Drive (i-MMD) hybrid transaxle works in the CR-V, Accord, Insight and Clarity hybrids. It walks through the system's three modes of operation.
why: HN recommends it as a clear explanation of a mind-blowingly simple power-split hybrid design.

quote.text: Some of these designs are mind-blowingly simple. My favorite is Honda's E-drive
